label: CLAUDE_BUILT_CLAUDE_CHECKED
path_root: cas_only_reasoner/FOR CODEX TO BUILD CAS NATIVE COGNITIVE MACHINE/
rule: A lock field is FILLED only when its complete value is established by RUN_RECORD, PACKAGE_CODE, PACKAGE_CODE_WITH_PINNED_LIBRARY_DEFAULT or IMAGE_METADATA evidence. Every other field holds the exact marker and is a BLOCKER. Nothing was taken from the laptop, and nothing was guessed. SAME_IMAGE_OTHER_JOB candidates are listed with their citations but are not written into the lock.

evidence_classes.RUN_RECORD: A committed receipt of the Helm 2.0 seed-17 run itself (seeds 18 and 19 corroborate).
evidence_classes.PACKAGE_CODE: Code of the pinned package (source 20208c92, archive c42370c4) that the run executed and passed through; the run completed.
evidence_classes.PACKAGE_CODE_WITH_PINNED_LIBRARY_DEFAULT: As PACKAGE_CODE, where the package leaves a setting at the pinned library's documented default (torch 2.11.0+cu128, run-recorded).
evidence_classes.IMAGE_METADATA: The cloud provider's own description (describe_images) of the recorded, immutable AMI.
evidence_classes.SAME_IMAGE_OTHER_JOB: A record from a DIFFERENT job on the same AMI and instance type. NOT accepted as establishing a Helm 2.0 value here; shown only as a candidate for a Codex ruling.

image.ami_id.why: Each seed receipt preflight.json records the AMI the run was launched from.

image.provider.why: The run priced and launched an Amazon EC2 instance: its preflight quotes ServiceCode AmazonEC2 and its launch record names EC2 instance i-002bc241f50ca41b5. "aws" is the provider name the lock uses.

image.region.why: Each seed receipt preflight.json records region us-west-2.

runtime.machine.why: The provider's own description of the recorded AMI gives Architecture x86_64; an x86_64 image boots only an x86_64 machine, which reports machine x86_64.

runtime.os.why: The run passed the worker preflight, which calls _cuda(), whose execution_guard() refuses unless platform.system() == "Linux"; the run completed. The AMI record also says Linux/UNIX.

libraries.torch.why: The worker recorded torch.__version__ in worker_report.json runtime.torch_version (all three seeds) and refuses to run unless it is exactly 2.11.0+cu128.

numerics.cudnn_allow_tf32.why: The worker preflight the run executed sets torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = False.

numerics.deterministic_algorithms.why: The worker preflight the run executed sets torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True).

numerics.dtype.why: The learner builds its parameters as float32 (explicit dtype=torch.float32, or torch's default float32 for nn.Linear/LayerNorm). Nothing in the shipped archive changes the default dtype or uses autocast, half or bfloat16 casts. The run's checkpoint records its encoder tensors as float32LE.

numerics.environment_variables.why: The worker preflight sets CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 before torch is imported. No module the run loaded sets a thread or numerics variable (the run's own loaded_sources.json lists none of the package modules that do). The other variables the bootstrap sets (PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE, AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS, AWS_PAGER, CAS_META2_RUN_TEACHING_CYCLE) do not affect predictions and are not lock values. See disclosed residual R1: no record lists the rest of the process environment.

numerics.float32_matmul_precision.why: Nothing in the shipped archive calls set_float32_matmul_precision or sets fp32_precision, and the preflight sets matmul allow_tf32 = False. In the pinned torch 2.11.0 (version recorded by the run), "highest" is the default and is the setting equivalent to allow_tf32 = False.
numerics.float32_matmul_precision.library_semantics: PyTorch 2.11.0, docstring of torch.set_float32_matmul_precision (torch/__init__.py): the "highest" setting is the default, equivalent to setting torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False. Public library documentation; this checker does not re-read it.

numerics.matmul_allow_tf32.why: The worker preflight the run executed sets torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False.

numerics.seeds.why: The seed-17 run recorded model_seed, encoder_seed and source_seed in worker_report.json design, and python_seed in the checkpoint init_args; the worker builds the learner with python_seed=model_seed.

libraries.cudnn.why_not_established: The Helm 2.0 bootstrap installed torch==2.11.0 from the cu128 index without hashes and recorded neither the installed wheels nor torch.backends.cudnn.version().

candidate.why: Two other jobs that installed torch==2.11.0 from the same index on the same AMI show pip resolving nvidia-cudnn-cu12==9.19.0.56 as a pin of torch itself. torch reports cuDNN as major.minor.patch (91900), so the lock form would be 9.19.0.

libraries.packages.why_not_established: The field needs every installed wheel with name, version and SHA-256. The Helm 2.0 bootstrap installed torch and requirements-gpu.txt without hashes and recorded no installed-package list, so no SHA-256 of any third-party wheel and no transitive dependency version is recorded. No other job installed the same requirement set on the same date, so there is no complete candidate.
libraries.packages.to_resolve: No public historical record can complete this field. Only a ruling that changes what the field must contain for a historical run could; otherwise it stays a blocker.

numerics.thread_counts.why_not_established: No module the run loaded sets a thread count, so torch used its machine-dependent default, and no record captured torch.get_num_threads() or the CPU count.

established_part.note: The run set no thread count (no loaded module sets one).

numerics.thread_counts.to_resolve: No public historical record can establish this field. It stays a blocker unless Codex rules otherwise.

disclosed_residuals.text: The lock holds the one prediction-affecting variable the package sets. No record lists the rest of the Helm 2.0 process environment, so the ABSENCE of other prediction-affecting variables (for example NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE, PYTHONHASHSEED, OMP_NUM_THREADS) is not recorded. It is disclosed here, not written as a blocker, because revision 5 refuses a lock whose environment_variables lacks the pinned CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG.
